before: In suggesting mode, bulleted list, numbered list, and list indent changes from the editor applied without a w:pPrChange. A bullet press recorded the paragraph only when it also applied the List Paragraph style.
after: These changes write a w:pPrChange attributed to the suggesting author, with one review item per press. A document that sets w:doNotTrackFormatting applies them untracked, like other paragraph formatting. List definitions in numbering.xml stay untracked.
reason: The editor now attaches a revision to setListNumbering and setListLevel ops. Automation in suggesting mode already emits these ops with a revision, so released participants already apply them. The replicated result is the existing w:pPrChange paragraph property record. No stored field, operation kind, or identity rule changes.
